# Context and Motivation {background-image="assets/bg1.png"}
## EICAT Assessments {background-image="assets/bg1.png"}
- **E**nvironmental **I**mpact **C**lassification for **A**lien **T**axa
- Assess impcats on native species
- Identify impact mechnism and category

## Problem {background-image="assets/bg1.png"}
- Potentially hundreds of academic texts
    - Screen
    - Read
    - Report

## Enter LLMs {background-image="assets/bg1.png"}
- **L**arge **L**anguage **M**odels

## Hypothesis {background-image="assets/bg1.png"}
- Large Language Models will identify invasive-species impacts, based on EICAT guidelines, in academic texts with performance approaching human annotators.
- Given correctly identified impacts, Large Language Models will assign EICAT categories and confidence Ratings with high accuracy and achieve good scores for justification reasoning.
- Differences between LLM and gold-standard annotations will be partly explained by inherent “task ambiguity” such that low LLM performance on certain references will coincide with low human–human agreement.

# System Design Overview {background-image="assets/bg2.png"}

## EICAT Workflow {background-image="assets/bg2.png"}
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A(Species Selection & Name Lookup) --> B(Literature Search & Retrieval)
  B --> C(Data Extraction)
  C --> D(Report Generation)

  F(Data Extraction) --> G(Identify Impact Mechanism)
  F --> H(Assign EICAT Category)
  F --> I(Decide Confidence Level)
  G --> J(Report Generation)
  H --> J
  I --> J
```

## AI Workflow {background-image="assets/bg2.png"}
```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A(Convert to MD) --> B(Extract Relevant Text Excerpts)
  B --> C(Identify Impact Mechanism)
  C --> D(Assign EICAT Category)
  D --> E(Decide Confidence Level)
```
